summary: Frontend-only testing of the newly added WhatsApp Business button beside the ChatBot on the homepage. All 5 requested test criteria passed: WhatsApp button visible at bottom-right, has correct green branding color (#25D366 => rgb(37,211,102)), clicking opens wa.me link with phone 917979837079 in a new tab (verified via context.expect_page, redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=%2B917979837079 with the pre-filled message), chatbot button is still visible and positioned above the WhatsApp button (chatbot y=928, WhatsApp y=1000), and both buttons are clickable with hover effects (tooltip 'Chat on WhatsApp' appears on hover — confirmed via screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): In /app/src/components/WhatsAppButton.tsx line 14, the regex `/[^\d+]/g` preserves the leading '+' character. WhatsApp's official click-to-chat spec recommends only digits (no '+', '-', or parentheses) after wa.me/. The generated URL currently is `https://wa.me/+917979837079?...` which still works (auto-redirects to api.whatsapp.com correctly) but is technically non-conformant. Recommended fix: use `/\D/g` so the URL becomes `https://wa.me/917979837079?...`.

The tooltip `<span>` inside the anchor uses `absolute` positioning but the parent `<a>` is not `relative`. It still renders correctly because the parent wrapper div in App.tsx has `fixed` positioning creating a containing block, but adding `relative` to the anchor would make the component self-contained and reusable.
